news.title: Without Saying His Name, Ken Paxton’s Estranged Wife Tells Texans to Vote For Him
news.summary: In a new ad, the wife of Ken Paxton, who is divorcing him for alleged adultery, tells Texas voters to focus on the “whole team,” not “individual players.”
